messages:
maya: Hey folks, onboarding q for contractor work: I have a contractor who needs access to a subset of prod secrets for a 2-week engagement. What's our recommended pattern for minimizing blast radius and making the creds short-lived?
frank: Welcome @maya! We provision contractor access via time-limited service accounts and Vault roles. Create a service account like contractor-<name>-proj-prod and request a Vault role with a 14d TTL.
leah: Important: require SSO-backed identity (OIDC) or GitHub team binding for the contractor. No long-lived static tokens. Add a justification and end date in the form.
maya: Do we have a template for the request? Also, any special approvals for contractors?
frank: Use the onboarding form and tag "contractor". Example: "Service account: contractor-jdoe-payments; Secrets: stripe-read-only; Access: Vault OIDC role bound to github:org/team; TTL: 14d; End date: 2026-05-10; Approvers: payments-eng, secops."
secops: For prod access we require an approved NDA + sponsor (team lead). We also enable additional audit logging and limit scopes (read-only if possible). If contractor needs escalation during incidents, pre-authorize an emergency contact.
maya: After the 14d TTL expires, is there an auto-revoke and key rotation?
leah: Yes 14d role TTL will expire and tokens become invalid. We also schedule a rotation job for any static vendor keys they used; owners must rotate secrets after the engagement if the contractor had access.
devex-bot: Contractor secrets request SR-2026-999 created. Reviewer: secops. Tracker: https://redwood-internal/requests/SR-2026-999
maya: Thanks all. I'll submit and attach the NDA + sponsor info. Appreciate the quick help :pray:
